levels.surface: أبي زرعة بن عمرو بن جرير

notes: The bare «عن محمد» is a narrator named by a single word: kept as written, not completed to a full name (rule 9)
Abu Dhar is the last link: the Prophet's words are relayed by him, and his own «فقال أبو ذر خابوا وخسروا» is inside the report
The Prophet is not a link
